integrity.proof_basis: Exact combinatorial Alexander duality; two elementary collapses for each four-cycle; a free antipodal 2-cover of cubical two-skeleta; cellular Euler characteristic and the universal coefficient theorem.
integrity.reproducibility: verify_folded_cube_cut.py and verification_output.txt provide finite direct tests for dimensions 5 and 6; no machine proof of the infinite statement is claimed.

scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary three-cut complexes of antipodal-vertex quotient cubes in all dimensions d>=5; no assertion for d<5.
Determines reduced integral homology, not the homotopy type or integral automorphism-module structure of the cut complexes.
Finite checks at d=5 and 6 support but do not replace the all-dimensional cubical covering proof.
Literature coverage cannot be established absolutely; an unindexed equivalent computation remains possible.
title: Integral two-torsion in three-cut complexes of folded cubes
